title: 'Hobbymaxxing' reveals the anxiety behind treating leisure as a performance metric
claim: Describes the method: track hobbies with numbers, prioritize three at a time daily, then rotate to the next three; example of an 18-year-old with many hobbies.
excerpt: She picks three hobbies at a time to prioritize and practices them daily, then rotates to the next three after a set period.
